dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Haha! Oh, yeah, I'm busting a gut right now...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You are lying. You wouldn't even look me in the logic module port.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, come on! How am I meant to laugh at your jokes when they suck this bad? Logic me that, you... you robot!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: We will NOT continue! I've had enough, so please stop holding me at vacuum cleaner-point! I laughed, didn't I? Is that not good enough for you!?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Jahoda, please take a seat. I will continue telling jokes.
